result.summary: Fail: while the radial Knowledge Tree has strong fundamentals (clear legend with multi-channel shapes and sector hatching, C4 why_not explanation on the disabled focus button, A12 scrollbar with clipped continuation line, crisp zoom controls, and visible Esc exit), multiple blocking clarity and accessibility criteria fail at 100% 1920x1080 scale. Key defects include < 16x16 px crowded node icons and < 24x24 du targets at overview (A2, A10), label-over-node occlusion of «Охлаждаемая лопатка (компонент)» by «Плёночное охлаждение» at Step 3 and «Металлы 10/15» colliding with «Шаг 2 из 6» at Step 2 (A9), unboxed text («Узлов: 99 · открыто 51» and Step 5 year labels) crossed by edges and hatching with low contrast (C5, A3), dense hatching competing with low-contrast dependency edges and unknown nodes (C5, A4), missing year scale numbers at Step 3 and an unlabeled 4-bar HUD meter (C3), and conflicting visual/terminology signals such as «кольцо 3» vs «кольцо = 10 лет» and reused blue/dashed borders (C2, A5). Note that 150% scaling (A9), keyboard focus/navigation (A6, A7), reduced motion (A8), and Settings fallback (C7) cannot be verified from these static 100% frames.
